description: A lightweight, fast and customizable open-source Chinese input method (IME), designed for Wubi and code-table schemes, with Quanpin/Shuangpin support.
notes: WindInput is installed system-wide by its own installer (an input method has to register with the system).
'scoop uninstall' keeps your user dictionaries and settings; use 'Settings > Apps' to remove them as well.

script: if (!(Invoke-ExternalCommand "$dir\$fname" -ArgumentList '--silent' -RunAs -Activity 'Running WindInput installer...' -ContinueExitCodes @{ 3010 = 'Installed. Restart Windows to finish cleaning up files that were in use.' })) { abort 'WindInput installer failed.' }
if (!$arp -or !$arp.InstallLocation) { warn 'WindInput is not registered in Apps & Features, nothing to uninstall.'; return }

if (!(Invoke-ExternalCommand (Join-Path $arp.InstallLocation 'uninstall.exe') -ArgumentList @('--silent', '--keep-user-data') -RunAs -Activity 'Running WindInput uninstaller...' -ContinueExitCodes @{ 3010 = 'Uninstalled. Restart Windows to finish cleaning up files that were in use.' })) { abort 'WindInput uninstaller failed.' }
